## What's free

Free name.is-a.dev subdomains, but no NS delegation to DNS hosts such as Cloudflare, so they can't be a zone for the cloudflare stack

> Free tiers change without notice. Check <https://is-a.dev> before relying on this.

## Notes

Excluded: names are records in is-a.dev's own zone (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT and a few more), added by GitHub pull request. NS records are only granted to SaaS that requires them, not for Cloudflare or self-hosting, and sites must be non-commercial software projects.
